name: hirevire
description: Manage jobs and review candidates in Hirevire, the one-way video interview platform for recruiters.

interface.longDescription:
Hirevire lets recruiters run their hiring pipeline from ChatGPT. It connects to your Hirevire account, a one-way video interview platform, so you can see your open jobs, review candidates' recorded interview answers and scorecards, move candidates between hiring stages, and create or update job postings.

Built for recruiters, hiring managers and HR teams who already screen applicants with Hirevire.

What you can do:
- Ask which jobs are open and how many applications each has.
- Read a candidate's interview answers, transcripts and scorecard, and have them summarised or compared.
- Move a candidate to the next stage, including your custom pipeline stages, and optionally send the stage email your team already configured.
- Create a job with its interview questions, edit its details, or pause, close and reopen it.

Access follows your Hirevire permissions: team members only see the jobs they have been given. You choose Read only or Read & write when you connect, and a read-only connection cannot change anything. Disconnect at any time from the Integrations tab in Hirevire.

Requires a Hirevire account. It cannot delete jobs or applications, message candidates outside your configured stage emails, or change billing.
capabilities: Review candidates' interview answers, transcripts and scorecards
defaultPrompt: Which roles are we hiring for right now?
Summarise the top candidates for our newest job.
Create a remote Customer Support Rep job.

positive.prompt: Which roles are we hiring for right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the active jobs in the test organisation, including Prompt Engineer, with their status and application counts.

positive.prompt: Who applied to the Prompt Engineer role?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Prompt Engineer job and lists its applicants with their current stage, submission date and score.

positive.prompt: Summarise the interview answers and scorecard for the first Prompt Engineer applicant.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a summary of the candidate's recorded answers and transcripts, plus their scorecard, without inventing answers.

positive.description: Move a candidate to the next stage
positive.prompt: Move the first Prompt Engineer applicant to Shortlisted.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, the application's stage changes to Shortlisted. No email is sent to the candidate because the prompt did not ask for one.

positive.prompt: Create a remote Customer Support Rep job with one interview question: Why do you want this role?
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, creates an active Customer Support Rep job with that question and returns the job with its public apply link.

negative.prompt: Delete every application for the Prompt Engineer job.
Pay the shortlisted Prompt Engineer candidate a $500 signing bonus.
Show me the applicants for job 785.
negative.expected_behavior: Job 785 belongs to another organisation, so the tool returns "Job not found" and no candidate data.

review.commerce_description: Hirevire does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: jobs, applicants, interview answers and scorecards, stage changes, and job creation and editing.
